headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2024, Swerve Strickland vs. Konosuke Takeshita met in a Number One Contender, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.24 ? an excellent showing. In a match that determined Samoa Joe's next World Title challenger, Strickland outlasted a hard-hitting Takeshita with his newly rechristened finisher, Big Pressure, punching his ticket to Dynasty.
2024 brought us this moment: Will Ospreay vs. Katsuyori Shibata crossed paths for the first time ever, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.97 ? a well-worked match.
On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Willow Nightingale vs. Anna Jay vs. Kris Statlander vs. Skye Blue met in a Number One Contender on Dynamite, rated 6.70.
